the use of the TTC approach, together with the application of the safety procedure for NFCs, is a useful tool to evaluate the safety of NFCs.

the application of the updated procedure for the evaluation of the NFCs derived from clove (Eugenia caryophyllata), cinnamon leaf (Cinnamomum burmanii), and West Indian bay (Pimenta racemosa) resulted in the confirmation of the GRAS status for all eight NFCs.

The main takeaway from our work is that

, in addition to the safety evaluation of individual constituents of natural flavor complexes, the use of a TTC for mixtures can be an important tool in the safety assessment of complex flavor mixtures.

the application of the conservative TTC approach together with the evaluation of toxicology and metabolism of the congeneric groups provides a robust approach for the safety evaluation of natural flavor complexes.
the use of the conservative TTC approach in combination with the available toxicological and exposure information is an appropriate and scientifically sound method to evaluate the safety of NFCs.
